limitations.detail: E084 is a cutoff-safe historical target-by-target diagnostic with a single fixed challenger and no parameter search. It is not an independent external nested validation and cannot satisfy the policy's nested/rolling plus prospective confirmation requirement.

The stored Node runner was hash-verified but not launched in a Node runtime. The actual calculation was executed in the connected JavaScript isolate using an inline implementation matching the stored algorithm. See E084_EXECUTION_MODE_ADDENDUM_20261126.json.
The prospective minimum target count and completion rule remain null. No substitute value was invented.
